description: Maps Lane B (#532): a find-a-vendor-near-a-property question ('find a plumber near <property>') must reach the find_places_near_property tool — the live-Maps Places lookup — NOT properties_near (that's Lane A, 'which of MY properties are near X') and NOT the Buildium own-vendor list. This is the exact capability behind the '74 Grove' thrash screenshot; 099 covers Lane A but Lane B had no golden case. find_places_near_property is mocked so the reply is deterministic and the tool's real Maps-key/PostGIS/resolve-property requirements don't apply in the harness (same mocking pattern as 099 / 040's buildium_get_property). Dogfood-proven (20/20 live-Gemini grid) and single-run-gated, with a must-not-reach guard on the Lane-A tool.
